title: Flying range
figureTitle: Flying range: chase view and FPV goggles

modes.qrtl: QRTL (fly home, land as a drone)

pendingDesign: Design changed: it applies when you reset to the pad, so this flight keeps going.

msg.hintAlt: Hold W to climb, arrows to fly
msg.hintRace: Fly through the gates in order
msg.hintAuto: The autopilot is flying: switch mode to take over
msg.armBlockedCrashed: Crashed: press R (or Reset) to put it back on the pad
msg.armBlockedAir: Already in the air: land first
msg.armBlockedThrottle: Arming blocked: throttle not at zero (that is a safety rule, not a bug)
msg.armBlockedBattery: Arming blocked: the battery is empty. Reset to fit a fresh pack
msg.bellyLanding: Belly landing on the grass. {mah} mAh used. Press R to go again
msg.lowBattery: LOW BATTERY: land now ({v} V per cell)
msg.batteryEmptyLipo: Battery empty: the ESCs cut out. Never fly a LiPo this low
msg.batteryEmptyLiion: Battery empty: the Li-ion pack hit its cut-off voltage. The ESCs cut out
msg.outOfField: Out of the field: turn back or press R
msg.farOut: A long way out: switch to return-to-home, or press R
msg.ceiling: Height limit for this field: {m} m
msg.desync: Desync! The ESC lost motor {motor}: the craft yaws and sinks. Land and let it cool
msg.motorOut: Motor {motor} failed: the mixer spreads its thrust over the others
msg.stall: STALL: too slow, the nose drops
msg.transition: Transition: the motors tilt forward and the wing takes the weight
msg.hoverAgain: Back in hover: the motors tilt up
msg.rtl: Return to launch: climbing, flying home, landing
msg.windOn: Wind on: {speed} m/s from the {dir}, with gusts
msg.armBlockedAcc: Arming blocked: ACC not calibrated. Run Calibrate accelerometer on the bench
msg.hintDemo: The autopilot is flying the course: switch mode to take over
msg.demoTime: Demo done in {time} s: the autopilot's time does not count

legend.title: Controls
legend.throttleAlt: In altitude-hold modes the throttle asks for a climb rate and springs back to hover.
legend.throttleManual: In angle and acro modes the throttle stays where you leave it, like a real throttle stick.
legend.acroNote: Acro: the sticks set the rotation rate and nothing levels the craft for you.
legend.angleNote: Angle: the sticks set the tilt and the craft levels itself when you let go.
legend.focusNote: Keys work while the range or its buttons have focus.

gamepad.title: Gamepad mapping
gamepad.none: No gamepad found. Connect one and press any button.

hit.ground: Crashed into the ground: props broken
hit.groundWing: Hit the ground too fast or too steep
hit.flipFc: Flipped on take-off: the flight controller is mounted the wrong way round
hit.flipProps: Flipped on take-off: the props are on the wrong motors
hit.flipMotor: Flipped on take-off: motor direction was never checked (bench: Check motor direction)

demoHint: The autopilot flies this course's line with the same physics you fly. Watch it, then beat it: its times never count.
